sourceNote: 根据你曾出现的错误结构制作的教学例句；不是你的原作文逐字摘录，也不是官方试题。

exercises.title: opportunities 后怎样接动作
exercises.original: Students have fewer opportunities study practical skills.
exercises.target: Students have fewer opportunities to study practical skills.
exercises.meaning: 学生学习实用技能的机会较少。
exercises.hint: 检查 opportunities 后面的动词形式。
exercises.explanation: opportunities to do something：做某事的机会。fewer 修饰可数复数 opportunities。
exercises.transfer: 换成社区义工：说明青少年有更多机会认识不同背景的人。

exercises.title: help somebody do / to do
exercises.original: Parents can help their children doing their homework.
exercises.target: Parents can help their children do their homework.
alternatives: Parents can help their children to do their homework.
exercises.meaning: 家长可以帮助孩子做功课。
exercises.hint: help 后已经有宾语 their children，后面的动作不需要 doing。
exercises.explanation: help somebody do 或 help somebody to do 都可以。这里两种写法都接受。
exercises.transfer: 换成学校社团：说明义工怎样帮助年幼学生学游泳。

exercises.title: take care of oneself
exercises.original: Young people should learn to take care by themselves.
exercises.target: Young people should learn to take care of themselves.
alternatives: Young people should learn to look after themselves.
exercises.meaning: 年轻人应该学习照顾自己。
exercises.hint: 区分 take care of themselves（照顾自己）与 by themselves（独自）。
exercises.explanation: take care of + 人；主语 young people 对应反身代词 themselves。
exercises.transfer: 把主语换成 I，用完整句子写出自己独立照顾自己的目标。

exercises.title: organise 的语境拼写
exercises.original: The school can orange some classes for parents.
exercises.target: The school can organise some classes for parents.
exercises.meaning: 学校可以为家长组织一些课程。
exercises.hint: orange 是橙子／橙色；这里需要表示“组织”的动词。
exercises.explanation: 英式拼写 organise。can 后用动词原形。
exercises.transfer: 写一句建议，让社区中心组织免费的游泳课程。

exercises.title: 情态动词后的原形
exercises.original: Students should learns how to manage their time.
exercises.target: Students should learn how to manage their time.
exercises.meaning: 学生应该学习怎样管理时间。
exercises.explanation: should / can / must + 动词原形，不加 s。此题是补充诊断练习。
exercises.transfer: 写一句建议，说明家长可以怎样支持孩子。

exercises.title: 数量与名词单复数
exercises.original: There are many useful activity at the centre.
exercises.target: There are many useful activities at the centre.
exercises.meaning: 中心有很多有用的活动。
exercises.hint: many 后面需要可数名词复数。
exercises.explanation: activity 的复数为 activities。此题是补充诊断练习。
exercises.transfer: 写一句话介绍学校里两项有趣的活动。

exercises.title: 用 because 保持句子完整
exercises.original: Because the course is free. More families can join it.
exercises.target: Because the course is free, more families can join it.
alternatives: More families can join the course because it is free.
exercises.meaning: 因为课程免费，所以更多家庭可以参加。
exercises.hint: Because 引导的原因不能单独当作完整句子。
exercises.explanation: 把原因从句连接到有主语和谓语的主句。此题是补充诊断练习。
exercises.transfer: 说明游泳为什么能帮助人们结交朋友，用 because 写一句完整句。

exercises.title: fewer 与 less
exercises.original: Children have less chances to play outdoors.
exercises.target: Children have fewer chances to play outdoors.
exercises.meaning: 孩子在户外玩的机会较少。
exercises.hint: chances 是可数复数，选择与它搭配的数量词。
exercises.explanation: fewer + 可数复数；less + 不可数名词。
exercises.transfer: 写一句话比较参加社团前后你看手机的时间。

paper2.title: 2025 Part A · 852 Teen Art Club
paper2.source: 用户的 2025 P2.pdf · Part A · Question 1 · 印刷第 2 页
paper2.prompt:
For question 1, write about 200 words in the space provided on pages 3–4.

You work at the 852 Teen Art Club in Hong Kong. The club has asked you to write an information leaflet promoting the club. Below is the first page of the leaflet. Write the second page of the leaflet using the three headings below. The first one has been provided for you.

• Our background
• A club member’s most memorable experience
• Our future activities
checks: 三个指定标题与所需内容均已覆盖
是宣传俱乐部的 information leaflet，语气适合潜在参加者
成员经历有具体细节，未来活动清楚可理解
背景、过去经历与未来计划的时态已逐一检查
约 200 词，并复查拼写、单复数和句子结构

paragraphs.title: 给同学一段建议
paragraphs.prompt: 一位同学想参加新活动，但担心自己做不好。写 80–120 词，给出两条具体建议，并解释每条建议怎样帮助他。
checks: 每条建议都有原因或例子
语气友善，适合写给同学
每个句子有完整主语与谓语
复查机会、help、情态动词和单复数

paragraphs.title: 推荐社区课程
paragraphs.prompt: 社区中心正计划开设免费课程。写 80–120 词，建议一种课程，说明目标参加者、两项益处和一个可执行安排。
checks: 清楚说明课程和参加者
提出一个具体可行的安排
检查 organise 的拼写与动词形式
